findings.claim: Spotify Q2 2026 reported 300M Premium subscribers and 777M MAUs, up 11% and 12% y/y, though earnings missed expectations.
findings.source: Tribune (Express Tribune) - Spotify tops 300 million paid subscribers despite earnings miss

findings.claim: Q1 2026: Spotify added 3M Premium subscribers to 293M despite US price hikes (individual plan $11.99 to $12.99 from Feb 2026); softer North America subscriber dynamics tied to short-term churn from the January price adjustment.
findings.source: theatdb - Spotify Q1 revenue rises 8%, premium subscribers inch up to 293 million amid US price hikes

findings.claim: Management reported steady retention after price increases across 150+ markets; CFO flagged small churn amount; Q4 net adds guide ~8M.
findings.source: RSM UK - Spotify results: streaming becomes more expensive, but users keep listening
findings.excerpt: Those costs are now being passed through to subscribers in the form of price increases, however, Management notes that so far it has had no material impact on subscriber churn.

note: No 2027/2028 sub consensus found in free sources; Q3 2026 consensus ~302M only from secondary aggregator (Octagon AI). Royalty cost pressure from label streaming 2.0 deals (+5-6%) reported by secondary source, not verified. 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
